Thus, the Governor and the Members of • [he Sangguniang (sic) should be notified that the two (sic) legislative measures are null and void, and they must withdraw the Phi/GEPS Invitation to Bid. " In reply thereto, please be informed that since Resolution No. 092, series of 2009 and Appropriation Ordinance 06, series of 2009 had undergone the procedural process for their enactment under the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160), the same are considered valid unless declared otherwise by our courts of justice. Any issues or questions thereon as to the substantive validity and enforceability of the aforesaid legislative measures should be threshed out by filing a special civil action for Declaratory Relief before the proper court in accordance with Section 1, Rule 63 of the Revised Rules of Court, which provides that: "SECTION 1. Who may file petition.—any person interested under a deed, will, contract or other written instrument, or whose rights are affected by a statutory executive order or regulation, or ordinance may, before breach

-2- or violation thereof, bring an action in the appropriate Regional trial Court to determine any question of construction or validity arising, and for a declaration of his rights or duties thereunder."
